# Agent2Learn

> A local-first CLI that turns the material available through a University of Waterloo student's own
> LEARN (D2L Brightspace) account into a durable local vault — original files beside Markdown twins,
> a stable index, and citations that resolve to ordinary paths and line numbers — so a coding agent
> can quote a course instead of guessing about it. Reads the student's own account only, over
> ordinary GET requests against D2L's student API. Discussions and grades are off by default,
> licensed eTextbooks and library e-resources are never downloaded, there is no telemetry and no
> passive version check, and uploads are disabled in this build and always require a confirmation
> phrase typed at the user's own terminal. `a2l check` reports what lexical retrieval matched in the
> student's own course files, with citations; it does not grade work or establish correctness.
> Not affiliated with the University of Waterloo or D2L Corporation.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what it is, the three supported install options, what it does and does not
  do, and the privacy defaults.
- [Install guide for agents](docs/install.md): the same install content written as instructions to
  an agent, including what an agent must not do on the user's behalf.
- [Disclaimer](DISCLAIMER.md): non-affiliation and the user's responsibility for course rules.

## Using it

- [FAQ](docs/FAQ.md): PATH and "command not found", Windows terminals and long paths, missing
  Tesseract, disk usage, moving the vault, uninstalling, grades on and off, why disabling collection
  differs from purging, why submission may stay release-disabled, and the difference between an
  upload preview and a verified upload.
- [Authentication](docs/AUTHENTICATION.md): the dedicated browser profile, same-device cookie
  scoping, Duo, keyring versus file fallback, expiry exit code 75, `--paste`, `--clear-profile`, and
  recovery paths that never involve sending credentials to anyone.

## Data and safety

- [Privacy](docs/PRIVACY.md): a table of what is stored and where, every external network action and
  who is contacted, report redaction, and the exact deletion commands with their honest limits.
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability.
- [Third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): dependency licences.

## Extending and deciding

- [Porting to another school](docs/PORTING.md): the `School` protocol, `uwaterloo.py` as the worked
  reference, every required field and method, and how to test an adapter offline.
- [Deferred decisions](docs/FUTURE.md): what was deliberately left out of v0.1 and what evidence
  would justify revisiting it, including the historical converter record.
- [Launch gates](docs/LAUNCH.md): the checks that must pass before anything is published.

## Optional

- [Implementation context](AGENTS.md): the internal contributor briefing, authoritative for
